_readme: Which audit runs when a file changes, read by hooks/audit_on_edit.py, and (for entries marked preCommit) by bin/run_precommit_audits.py. audit_on_edit.py is advisory only — nothing it runs can block a tool call or write a file. run_precommit_audits.py is the opposite on purpose: it is what bin/install_precommit_hook.py wires into .git/hooks/pre-commit (or a .pre-commit-config.yaml local hook), and it DOES fail the commit when a preCommit entry reports something. Only mark an entry preCommit if it is both fast (seconds, every commit) and invariant (a real regression, not a judgment call) — see the field's own description in hooks.map.schema.json. Both preCommit entries here are wholely mechanical: error-handling bypasses are deterministic greps, and the network-coupling fallback is a construction pattern, not prose judgement.
